subtitle: From Supplier to Customer
sentences: Today, I would like to talk about supply chain management, a key subject in MBA operations courses.
A supply chain includes every step that brings a product from raw materials to the final customer.
Effective supply chain management reduces costs, improves quality, and delivers products on time.
However, global supply chains also face risks such as natural disasters, trade conflicts, and pandemics.
That is why modern companies try to balance efficiency with flexibility and resilience.
For example, Toyota became famous for its just-in-time system, which keeps inventory low and quality high.
